# MDD Sim Gateway v1.5.4

## 中文

### 0. 重要更新说明

- v1.5.3 及更早版本生成的“脱敏支持包”可能仍包含代理条目或出口节点的名称，以及主机网络
  地址。v1.5.4 已按字段所在路径补齐脱敏；分享旧支持包前请继续人工检查，已经公开且未人工
  处理的旧附件应删除或替换。

### 1. 本次小版本更新

- [Issue #21](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/21)：线路健康恢复删除旧容器后，
  若恰好撞上读卡器身份短暂不可见，会误清除恢复计时并永久停在“需要处理”。现在短暂缓存缺失
  会继续重试；真实拔卡或用户关闭 VoWiFi 仍会停止自动恢复。
- “全部版本”和“仅主版本”现在拥有独立更新目标。前者跟随获准推送的最新 Release；后者会按
  tag 安装策略中配置的稳定主版本，即使其后已经发布更新的补丁，落后的设备也不会错过主版本。
- 支持包现在隐藏代理配置名称和值、出口节点标签和主机网络地址，同时保留问题原因、隧道状态、
  重试计数和主机告警等诊断证据。

### 2. 当前大版本更新

- v1.5 系列加入余额与保号、语音信箱和未接来电通知、后台版本检查与受控自动更新，并为
  ARM64/amd64 提供经过校验的预构建 Engine 与 Control 资产。

---

## English

### 0. Important notice

- “Redacted support bundles” produced by v1.5.3 and earlier may still contain proxy-entry or
  exit-node labels and host network addresses. v1.5.4 adds path-aware redaction. Continue to
  review older bundles before sharing them, and remove or replace any unreviewed public attachment.

### 1. v1.5.4 patch update

- [Issue #21](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/21): after health recovery removed
  a failed container, a momentary gap in reader identity could erase its retry timer and leave the
  line permanently requiring attention. Transient cache gaps now remain eligible for retry; a real
  card removal or an operator-disabled VoWiFi switch still cancels recovery.
- “All versions” and “main versions only” now have independent targets. The former follows the
  approved latest Release; the latter installs the configured stable main Release by tag, so a
  lagging device can still reach it after newer patches have been published.
- Support bundles now hide proxy configuration labels and values, exit-node labels and host network
  addresses while retaining failure reasons, tunnel state, retry counts and host alerts.

### 2. Current major release

- The v1.5 series adds balance and number keeping, voicemail and missed-call notifications,
  background release checks and gated automatic updates, with verified prebuilt Engine and Control
  assets for ARM64 and amd64.
